Name: Powerups Migration Bridge
Author: Stefan Berg and the N.I.N.A. contributors

Descriptions.ShortDescription: Best-effort migration from the deprecated Powerups plugin to NINA's built-in instructions.
Descriptions.LongDescription: Powerups Migration Bridge helps you move sequences and templates from the deprecated Powerups plugin (3.29.x and 4.x) to NINA's built-in instructions. The original plugin is no longer maintained. Supported steps migrate when loaded; other steps remain editable and usable through the original runtime. Originals are backed up before migration. Migration is best effort: review sequences and save changes in NINA as usual.
